# HTMX PRO — Hyper Reactive Lean Framework Suite for Humans and AI Agents
> A hyperreactive, lean hypermedia-first application suite. Sub-48KB total footprint, zero Virtual DOM, zero NPM build step for logic.

## 🏛️ Core Philosophy
1. **Hypermedia First**: HTML is the primary medium over the wire; the server remains the authoritative source of truth.
2. **Deterministic & Agent-Native**: Machine-readable grammar (`/schema/htmxui.json`), numbered error codes (`HTMX PRO-BOLT-001..050`) with actionable fixes, and zero hallucination risk.
3. **Hyperreactive**: Fine-grained reactive signals, in-memory fuzzy search, 2D viewport virtualization, topological DAG formula calculations, and 60fps FLIP animations.
4. **Zero NPM Logic Runtime**: No React, no ReactDOM, no Redux/Zustand boilerplate, no hydration mismatches. Works with any backend (Python, Go, Rust, PHP, Bun, Node, Elixir).

---

## ⚡ The 10 Micro-Engines

| Engine | Bundle | Size | Primary Capabilities |
|---|---|---|---|
| **HxBolt** | `htmx-bolt.js` | ~2.5KB | Signal-based reactive state (`hx-state`), bindings (`hx-text`, `hx-show`, `hx-class`, `hx-style`), 2D sparse matrix (`HxBolt.matrix`), 60fps RAF stream throttle (`hx-stream-batch`). |
| **HxFlash** | `htmx-flash.js` | ~2.1KB | 0ms in-memory fuzzy search (`hx-flash-search`), multi-column filters (`hx-flash-filter`), TypedArray ColumnStore (`HxFlash.createColumnStore`). |
| **HxForm** | `htmx-form.js` | ~2.2KB | Declarative validation pipes (`hx-validate`), multi-step wizard (`hx-wizard`), cascading fields (`hx-depends`), cell transactions (`cellTransaction`). |
| **HxVibe** | `htmx-vibe.js` | ~1.8KB | 60fps FLIP layout animation (`hx-vibe-flip`), 3D card tilt (`hx-vibe-card`), magnetic cursor snapping (`hx-vibe-magnetic`), physics shockwave (`hx-vpx-blast`). |
| **HxA11y** | `htmx-a11y.js` | ~1.4KB | WAI-ARIA focus trapping (`hx-trap-focus`), roving tabindex (`hx-roving`), 2D matrix navigation (`hx-matrix-nav`, `Shift+Arrow` range selection). |
| **HxVirtual** | `htmx-virtual.js` | ~2.0KB | 1D & 2D bi-directional viewport windowing (`hx-virtual`, `hx-virtual-2d`), pinned sticky left/right columns (`hx-pinned-left`), 100k+ row recycling. |
| **HxGrid** | `htmx-grid.js` | ~3.2KB | Enterprise Data Grid (`<div hx-grid>`), interactive column resize handles, drag-and-drop column reordering, bulk actions, CSV export. |
| **HxCalc** | `htmx-calc.js` | ~2.1KB | Zero-dependency reactive formula engine with topological sorting DAG (Kahn's algorithm), cycle detection (`#CYCLE!`), coordinate resolver (`A1` $\leftrightarrow$ `(0, 0)`). |
| **HxOffline** | `htmx-offline.js` | ~1.6KB | IndexedDB offline mutation queue, optimistic local persistence, automatic sync on reconnect, 409 conflict resolution. |
| **HxDevTools**| `htmx-devtools.js`| ~1.2KB | In-browser visualizer (`HTMX PRO.devtools`), reactive signal inspector, mutation timeline profiler. |

---

## 📋 Attribute Grammar & Rules

### State & Signals
- `hx-state='{ "count": 0, "open": false }'`: Declares reactive context.
- Preferred AI safe syntax: `<script type="application/json" hx-state>{ "count": 0, "open": false }</script>`
- `hx-computed='{ "total": "price * qty" }'`: Memoized derived state.
- `hx-effect="console.log(count)"`: Runs side effect on signal mutation.
- `hx-text="count"`: Binds text content to expression.
- `hx-html="richText"`: Binds innerHTML (ensure content is sanitized).
- `hx-show="open"`: Toggles display with CSS transitions (`hx-transition="fade|slide|scale"`).
- `hx-if="isLoggedIn"`: Conditional mounting on `<template hx-if="...">`.
- `hx-for="(item, idx) in items"`: Loop rendering on `<template hx-for="...">`.
- `hx-class='{ "bg-primary text-white": active, "opacity-50": disabled }'`: Dynamic classes.
- `hx-style='{ width: progress + "%" }'`: Dynamic inline styles.
- `hx-model.number="qty"`: Two-way binding (`.lazy`, `.number`, `.trim`).

### HyperGrid & Spreadsheet Primitives
- `hx-cell="row,col"` / `hx-matrix-cell="row,col"`: Binds cell directly to `HxBolt.matrix` coordinate with $O(1)$ signal granularity.
- `hx-matrix="matrixName"`: Namespaces matrix signals.
- `hx-stream-batch="60fps"`: Groups incoming SSE/WS deltas into single RAF frame render.
- `hx-virtual-2d`: Enables X + Y viewport virtualization with `hx-pinned-left="2"`.
- `hx-matrix-nav`: Enables Excel-style 2D roving tabindex, Shift+Arrows bounding box range selection.
- `hx-ext="grid-delta"`: Parses `Δrow:col:val:flashClass` micro-delta streams.

### Validation & Forms
- `hx-validate="required|email|min:5|max:100|numeric|match:otherField"`: Pipeline validation.
- `hx-error-for="fieldName"`: Targets validation message placeholder.
- `hx-wizard`: Multi-step wizard wrapper (`hx-step="1"`, `hx-wizard-next`, `hx-wizard-prev`).
- `hx-depends="country->state,city"`: Cascading dependent select inputs.
- `hx-optimistic`: Optimistic mutation with automatic snapshot rollback on 4xx/5xx errors.

---

## 🛠️ HyperFX Global Scope Helpers (inside expressions & actions)
- `$store.storeName`: Access global reactive stores.
- `$refs.refName`: Access element tagged with `hx-ref="refName"`.
- `$el`: Current DOM element.
- `$event`: Current DOM event.
- `$copy(text)`: Clipboard copy.
- `$toast(message, 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error')`: Toast notification.
- `$sound('ping' | 'click' | 'whoosh' | 'success' | 'error')`: Web Audio procedural tone.
- `$blast({ radius: 250, force: 40 })`: Radial physics shockwave.
- `$focus(selector)`: Moves keyboard focus.
- `$toggle('propertyName')`: Inverts boolean state.
- `$undo()` / `$redo()`: State history travel.
- `$exportCSV('#grid', 'data.csv')`: Client-side CSV download.

---

## 🚨 Deterministic Error Codes for AI Self-Repair
- `HTMX PRO-BOLT-001`: Invalid JSON syntax in `hx-state` $\rightarrow$ Fix: Verify JSON quotes or use `<script type="application/json" hx-state>`.
- `HTMX PRO-BOLT-002`: Circular dependency in `hx-computed` $\rightarrow$ Fix: Remove self-referencing properties.
- `HTMX PRO-BOLT-003`: Invalid `hx-for` syntax $\rightarrow$ Fix: Use `item in items` or `(item, index) in items` on `<template>` tag.
- `HTMX PRO-BOLT-004`: Undefined property or global store $\rightarrow$ Fix: Register via `HxBolt.store('name', initial)` or declare in local `hx-state`.
- `HTMX PRO-BOLT-005`: Attribute typo detected $\rightarrow$ Fix: Check suggestion in warning (e.g. did you mean `hx-show` instead of `hx-showw`?).
- `HTMX PRO-CALC-002`: Circular reference `#CYCLE!` in formula $\rightarrow$ Fix: Break cyclic cell dependency.

---

## 🚀 Quickstart Example

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/htmx.org@2.0.4"></script>
  <script src="/htmx-bolt.js"></script>
  <script src="/htmx-flash.js"></script>
  <script src="/htmx-vibe.js"></script>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/styles/output.css">
</head>
<body class="p-8 bg-background text-foreground">

  <!-- Reactive Counter & Toast Card -->
  <div class="max-w-md p-6 border rounded-xl bg-card shadow-sm space-y-4"
       hx-state='{ "count": 0, "starred": false }'>
    
    <h2 class="text-xl font-bold">HTMX PRO Reactive Card</h2>
    <p class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Count: <span hx-text="count" class="font-mono font-bold">0</span></p>

    <div class="flex gap-2">
      <button hx-action="count++; $sound('click')" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-md text-sm">
        Increment
      </button>
      <button hx-action="$toggle('starred'); $toast(starred ? 'Starred!' : 'Unstarred', 'info'); $sound('ping')" 
              class="px-3 py-1.5 border rounded-md text-sm">
        <span hx-text="starred ? '★ Starred' : '☆ Star'">☆ Star</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

</body>
</html>
```
